trade.ui.title: Trade — three different ways
trade.ui.market_status: Day {day} · {tier} prices · Merchant purse: {purse} gold. Stock resets each morning. All prices below are TOTALS.
trade.ui.stock_short: Merchant has {stock}; need {amount}. Choose less or wait for morning stock.
trade.ui.gold_short: You have {gold} gold; need {price}. Choose less or earn more gold.
trade.ui.inventory_short: You own {own}; need {amount}. Choose less or gather more.
trade.ui.capacity_short: Merchant has room for {space}; selling {amount} exceeds the {limit} stock limit. Sell less, buy their stock, or wait for morning.
trade.ui.purse_short: Merchant has {purse} gold; must pay {price}. Sell less or buy from them to refill their purse.
trade.ui.item_bought: Bought {item}; paid {price} gold. Added to the armory.
trade.ui.community_title: 1. Village / town markets — choose resources and quantities
trade.ui.community_help: Buy and sell colony resources, or buy specialty equipment. A living, non-downed colony unit must be near the community, its relation must be Neutral or better (0+), and it must not be ruined. Open a market to inspect stock and exact blockers; selecting the place alone does not send anyone there.
trade.ui.no_communities: No communities discovered. Explore the map to find a village or town, then send a colony unit there.
trade.ui.ready: Ready to trade: presence and relation requirements met.
trade.ui.airship_title: 2. Your airship — automated resource trade run
trade.ui.airship_help: Select your own airship and send it to a specific discovered trade post below. It flies there, trades for about 8 simulation seconds, then returns to your dock (or home dock point). This is not the village market. Sending a run replaces the ship's current order. Auto mode instead chooses the nearest known post when it next considers trading, at most once per day with surplus; otherwise it explores.
trade.ui.select_ship_help: Select a living player-owned airship using its button above or on the map. No selected airship: sending is unavailable.
trade.ui.cargo: Selected ship cargo limit: {cargo} resource units sold per run.
trade.ui.reserve_rules: Kept in reserve: wood 220, stone 160, ore 60, metal 80. At the post, sell half of each surplus (rounded down), in priority order metal → ore → wood → stone, until cargo is full. Base gold per unit: metal 2.5, ore 1, wood/stone 0.5; best colonist trade skill raises proceeds. Total sale gold is rounded down. Resources are read at trading time, not reserved at departure.
trade.ui.food_rules: Food now {food}; low-stock threshold {target} (population × 6). After selling, buy up to 40 food toward that threshold at 1.5 gold each, limited by available gold (now {gold}); payment rounds up. Food buying is independent of sale cargo and can happen with no surplus.
trade.ui.no_surplus: No surplus above reserves: a run sells nothing. It can still buy food if food is low and gold is available; otherwise there is no exchange.
trade.ui.rounding: Tiny / odd surplus: 1 extra sells 0, 2 sells 1, 3 sells 1 (the odd unit stays). Even a sale can earn 0 gold after rounding; this is not a failed flight.
trade.ui.no_posts: No trade posts discovered. Explore until a trade post is revealed. Airship runs cannot be sent from this panel without a known destination.
trade.ui.ship_downed: Selected airship is downed; recover it before giving a trade order.
trade.ui.ship_in_squad: Selected airship belongs to a squad. Remove it from the squad before giving an individual trade order.
trade.ui.merchant_title: 3. Visiting merchant — buy equipment at your dock
trade.ui.merchant_help: A merchant airship periodically visits a completed player sky dock. When it docks, it automatically exchanges surplus / food using the same rules above, and offers equipment for gold. This is a visitor, not your airship; equipment purchases go to the armory.
trade.ui.no_merchant: No merchant is docked. Build a sky dock and wait for a visit; the merchant's equipment shop is available only while docked.
trade.ui.auto_status: Auto: exploring / considering next trade run
trade.ui.dock_status: Dock order: returning or waiting at dock
trade.ui.show_rules: Show reserve, prices and food rules
